_note: Utterance-level eval for the Q3 understanding layer: does the bot pick the right reply register, and does it extract the right thing from code-switched, colloquial and regionally-coloured speech? Written by us after the lexicons, so treat the numbers as a regression check, not as native-speaker validation (GAP-005). 'expect' keys: register, slot (name=value), intent (objection id | question | escalation | yes | no | hardship).
